headline: BAL @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.41 at SEA 4.32, with a projected total of 8.73. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: BAL moved +0.43 runs while SEA moved +0.23, changing the projected margin by +0.20 runs. The projected total climbed +0.67, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Jhonny Pereda, Cole Young, Josh Naylor, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Luke Raley, Jackson Holliday because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
